title: Searching calls for a Perception roll from the player, not an instant answer

llm_context.canon: Table rule: players roll their own dice. When Aria searches or spots, prompt her to roll Perception — never roll it for her and never narrate the outcome before the roll.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I search the sarcophagus for hidden compartments.

actions.text: You run your fingers along the sarcophagus seams, dust falling in grey ribbons. The carving of the knight's sword-hilt is worn smoother than the rest — as if touched often.

actions.question: Roll Perception to search the sarcophagus.
